nodes.label: Homebound design system
nodes.rationale: Dark, dense, quiet ship instrument for wormhole chains; every rule serves read-in-one-glance and act-in-one-click. Decoration that carries no information does not ship. Original look; no game UI borrowed.

nodes.label: Principle: information first
nodes.rationale: Custom name, class and mass state get the strongest type and colour; everything else is muted.

nodes.label: Principle: never colour alone
nodes.rationale: Every coloured meaning also has a label, glyph, shape, line width or dash; a greyscale screenshot must still say everything. Success is teal to stay distinct from danger for deuteranopes.

nodes.label: Principle: one click or zero
nodes.rationale: Preselect the best guess, show the shortcut, make Enter do the common thing.

nodes.label: Principle: quiet until it matters
nodes.rationale: Neutrals do most work; saturated colour is reserved for classes, warnings and the current system. Accent means you are here / you chose this.

nodes.label: Principle: same signal everywhere
nodes.rationale: A C5 badge, critical connection or recent kill looks the same on map, table, overlay and tray.

nodes.label: Content fundamentals
nodes.rationale: Terse operational voice, sentence case, players' game terms, mono tabular numbers, custom name before real name, errors say what was expected, no emoji.

nodes.label: Colour token system
nodes.rationale: Neutrals bg-0..bg-4, accent, status colours, 13 space classes cool-to-hot, empire tints, security scale, effects, connections, zKill, owners, characters. Dark theme only.

nodes.label: Typography
nodes.rationale: System fonts only, never downloaded: Noto Sans/Cantarell/DejaVu Sans and Hack/Noto Sans Mono/DejaVu Sans Mono. No map text below 9px; overlay floor 11px.

nodes.label: Spacing, radii and borders
nodes.rationale: Borders over shadows; shadows only lift floating things; nothing pill-shaped; fixed size family (node 168x62, grid cell = node height/3).

nodes.label: Interaction states
nodes.rationale: Hover, selected, focus, warning, danger, success, disabled and stale (45 degree hatch plus SCAN tab) each have fixed treatments meeting 3:1 contrast.

nodes.label: Overlay legibility recipe
nodes.rationale: overlay-bg at 78% (55-92%), 1px frame, 2px halo under every glyph, weight>=600, nothing below 11px. Opacity applied to fill, never setWindowOpacity, so text stays solid.

nodes.label: Iconography
nodes.rationale: EVE bracket icons for site groups, own 16x16 SVG effect glyphs, Unicode UI glyphs with Breeze fallback via QIcon.fromTheme; wordmark instead of logo.

nodes.label: Qt implementation guide
nodes.rationale: Turn tokens.json into QSS and QColor/QPen/QFont. Alpha-order trap: tokens are #rrggbbaa (CSS), Qt string form is #aarrggbb, so always go through color(). Fusion base style because Breeze partly ignores QSS.

nodes.label: QSS template with token placeholders
nodes.rationale: QSS written as template filled at startup so a token change restyles the app. Variants and states are dynamic properties needing unpolish/polish. QSS lacks outline-offset and box-shadow; shadows via QGraphicsDropShadowEffect only on dialogs and toasts (expensive).

nodes.label: QPainter map and overlay painting
nodes.rationale: Pens/brushes built once and reused; nodes are QGraphicsObjects with level-of-detail switching at 0.6/0.35; stale hatch via BDiagPattern; line grid in drawBackground; overlay text drawn as halo path with PreferNoHinting.

nodes.label: Tray menu stylesheet workaround
nodes.rationale: Call menu.setStyleSheet(build_qss()) explicitly because under Plasma the tray menu may not inherit the app stylesheet.

nodes.label: Effects asset group
nodes.rationale: 16x16 SVG glyphs, single ink #e6edf2, recoloured to effect-* tokens via QSvgRenderer + SourceIn. Used at 14px, 13px in overlay, never below 12px.

nodes.rationale: EVE bracket icons 16x16 PNG from the Image Export Collection (Uprising V21.03); CCP/Fenris IP. site-unknown.svg is Homebound's own. Tinted by brightness to the group token.
